verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for an accounting SaaS, but the evidence pack documents no bulk export of all account data in open formats. The REST API is a developer building block for building one's own export. ZUGFeRD/XRechnung e-invoicing and sending files to a tax advisor are adjacent features, not a complete self-service data export, so none of them earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
